scope: Oracle candidate boxes/class hints/transcription; second baseline also sees oracle visible-role transcription. Neither performs OCR or reads image pixels. Rules were written after public release and are not blind/pre-registered. No trained model, inference or credit. Not detector performance.

literal_only.definition: Class-aware score-ordered IoU >= 0.5 matching at the submitted confidence cutoff; not mAP. Pixel coverage is necessary for redaction and distinct from IoU recall.

contrastive_pairs.rule: All focal sensitive fragments matched in sensitive arm AND no prediction covers >=25% of any focal benign candidate fragment in control arm.
